extra.ground_truth: Returns the maximum of prices[j] - prices[i] over j > i, or 0 when no profitable pair exists; buying and selling on the same day is not allowed.
extra.golden_response:
Reference approach (passes all 8 cases):

```python
class Solution:
    def maxProfit(self, prices: list[int]) -> int:
        best = 0
        lo = prices[0]
        for p in prices[1:]:
            best = max(best, p - lo)
            lo = min(lo, p)
        return best
```

Example: prices = [7,1,5,3,6,4] -> 5 (buy at 1, sell at 6).
Constraints: 1 <= len(prices) <= 10^5.
